description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI component called TalkOrbOverlay, which displays an animated orbiting circle (orb) with status text indicating speaking, listening, or thinking states. It handles animations, drawing graphics, and conditional display of status.

methods.name: TalkOrbOverlay
methods.description: Composable function rendering an animated, colorful orb with status text indicating 'Speaking', 'Listening', or 'Thinking'.
